2610.04893.title: SFlexRCA: Lightweight, Scalable, and Flexible Root Cause Analysis for IIoT Edge Systems
2610.04893.paper_summary: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems generate high-dimensional sensor telemetry from interconnected components, where faults can propagate across the system. To address these challenges, we propose SFlexRCA (Scalable and Flexible Root Cause Analysis), a topology-free RCA framework designed for resource-constrained IIoT environments. SFlexRCA transforms multivariate telemetry into compact orthogonal representations and applies shared lightweight linear modeling, avoiding explicit graph construction, message passing, and per-variable or lag-specific parameter growth. We evaluate SFlexRCA on three publicly available IIoT datasets, BATADAL, SWaT, and WADI, spanning different numbers of monitored variables, temporal characteristics, and training-data regimes. SFlexRCA is compared with 10 statistical, causal, and non-causal baselines in terms of RCA accuracy, training efficiency, inference latency, and memory consumption. In addition, inference efficiency and memory consumption are evaluated on Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi 5, while energy consumption is additionally measured on Raspberry Pi 5. We further investigate temporalcontext sensitivity, architectural and loss components, and alternative representations. Notably, SFlexRCA maintains strong localization performance on BATADAL despite its limited normal-operation training data, while its compact shared architecture avoids the parameter growth associated with causal and graph-based approaches. Its lightweight shared architecture further enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained IIoT edge devices. The SFlexRCA code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/RootCause- Analysis-Correlation-Attentive-Modeling.
2610.04893.paper_summary_zh: 工業物聯網 (IIoT) 系統從互聯的元件生成高維度的傳感器遙測，故障可能在系統中傳播。為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了 SFlexRCA（可擴展和靈活的根本原因分析），這是一個設計用於資源受限的 IIoT 環境的無拓撲 RCA 框架。SFlexRCA 將多變量遙測轉換為緊湊的正交表示，並應用共享的輕量線性建模，避免顯式圖構建、消息傳遞以及每個變量或延遲特定的參數增長。我們在三個公開可用的 IIoT 數據集上評估 SFlexRCA，分別是 BATADAL、SWaT 和 WADI，這些數據集涵蓋了不同數量的監控變量、時間特徵和訓練數據模式。SFlexRCA 與 10 個統計、因果和非因果基準進行比較，評估其 RCA 準確性、訓練效率、推理延遲和內存消耗。此外，推理效率和內存消耗在 Raspberry Pi 3 和 Raspberry Pi 5 上進行評估，而能耗則在 Raspberry Pi 5 上進行額外測量。我們進一步研究時間上下文敏感性、架構和損失組件以及替代表示。值得注意的是，儘管 BATADAL 的正常運行訓練數據有限，SFlexRCA 在定位性能上仍保持強勁，而其緊湊的共享架構避免了與因果和基於圖的方法相關的參數增長。其輕量級共享架構進一步實現了在資源受限的 IIoT 邊緣設備上的高效部署。SFlexRCA 的代碼可在 https://github.com/theamrzaki/RootCause-Analysis-Correlation-Attentive-Modeling 獲得。
